uiConfig.queryString: 'Log Source' = FOCUS_OCI and BillingCurrency != BillingCurrency | eval oci_AttributedCost = unit(oci_AttributedCost, currency_eur) | link includenulls = true Time, oci_CompartmentName, subAccountName, ServiceName | rename oci_CompartmentName as Compartment, subAccountName as Tenant, ServiceName as Service | eventstats distinctcount(Compartment) as Compartments, distinctcount(Tenant) as Tenants, distinctcount(Service) as Services, sum(oci_AttributedCost) as Consumption | eventstats rownum as S_Row, sum(oci_AttributedCost) as ServiceCost by Service | eventstats rownum as T_Row, sum(oci_AttributedCost) as TenantCost by Tenant | eventstats rownum as C_Row, sum(oci_AttributedCost) as CompCost by Compartment | sort -ServiceCost | addfields [ * | where ServiceCost > 0 and S_Row = 1 | createtable name = 'Service Summary' select Service as Name, ServiceCost as Cost ] | sort -TenantCost | addfields [ * | where TenantCost > 0 and T_Row = 1 | createtable name = 'Tenant Summary' select Tenant as Name, TenantCost as Cost ] | sort -CompCost | addfields [ * | where CompCost > 0 and C_Row = 1 | createtable name = 'Compartment Summary' select Compartment as Name, CompCost as Cost ] | timestats name = 'Consumption by Tenant' sum(oci_AttributedCost) as Cost by Tenant | timestats name = 'Consumption by Service' sum(oci_AttributedCost) as Cost by Service | timestats name = 'Consumption by Compartment' sum(oci_AttributedCost) as Cost by Compartment | fields target = ui -Compartments, -Tenants, -Services, -Consumption | fields -'*_Row', -'*Cost'
